topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the pedagogical structure, multi-disciplinary audience, and core learning objectives for the cancer biology lecture series.

topics.label: Biological concepts of oncogenesis, differentiation, and tissue architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe cancer as a progressive disease arising from genetic alterations and disrupted tissue differentiation, alongside laboratory approaches and limitations in modeling these multicellular structures.

topics.label: Invasion, metastasis, and the transition from benign to malignant tumours
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the biological and diagnostic differences between benign and malignant neoplasms, focusing on basement membrane invasion, metastatic dissemination, and stepwise disease progression.

topics.label: Neoplasm nomenclature and classification
topics.groupedBecause: It outlines the standardized rules, suffixes, and clinical exceptions used to name and classify benign and malignant tumors based on their tissue of origin.

topics.label: Mechanisms of cancer-induced morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: It details the anatomical, functional, and systemic pathways through which primary and metastatic tumors cause clinical illness and patient death.

topics.label: Comparative oncology and cancer incidence across species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyse cancer prevalence across human populations and diverse animal taxa to demonstrate that tumorigenesis is a fundamental vulnerability of multicellular organisms.

topics.label: Principles, histology, and modalities of cancer screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the clinical rationale, histological indicators, and practical efficacy of early screening programs across various cancer types.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and practical reminders
topics.groupedBecause: It wraps up the lecture with a concluding reminder of learning outcomes and practical session arrangements.
